description: This file contains implementation of elliptic curve operations and precomputation tables for Curve25519, including functions for point addition, multiplication, and conversion to byte arrays, as well as generating precomputed tables for cryptographic use.

methods.name: modp_inv
methods.description: Computes modular inverse of x modulo p.

methods.name: recover_x
methods.description: Recovers x-coordinate from y-coordinate and sign for the elliptic curve.

methods.name: point_add
methods.description: Adds two points on the elliptic curve.

methods.name: point_mul
methods.description: Multiplies a point by a scalar on the elliptic curve.

methods.name: to_bytes
methods.description: Converts a field element to a 32-byte array.

methods.name: to_ge_precomp
methods.description: Converts a point to a precomputed group element representation.

methods.name: to_base_25_5
methods.description: Converts an integer to base 25.5 limbs.

methods.name: to_base_51
methods.description: Converts an integer to base 51 limbs.

methods.name: to_literal
methods.description: Formats a field element as a C literal with conditional compilation.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Generates precomputed tables for Curve25519 and outputs C code.
